query:
// One row per ball carrier for the selected season and season type. Players
// traded mid-season have several team rows; they are summed and rates recomputed.
DEFINE
    VAR __Season = "2025"
    VAR __SeasonType = "REG"
    VAR __MinVolume = 100
    VAR __Grouped =
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
            'Player Season Summary'[player_key],
            'Player Season Summary'[player_name],
            TREATAS ( { __Season }, 'Player Season Summary'[season] ),
            TREATAS ( { __SeasonType }, 'Player Season Summary'[season_type] ),
            "@Pos", MAX ( 'Player Season Summary'[position] ),
            "@Teams", CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( 'Player Season Summary'[team_key] ), 'Player Season Summary'[team_key], "/" ),
            "@Att", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[rushing_attempts] ),
            "@Yds", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[rushing_yards] ),
            "@TD", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[rushing_tds] ),
            "@EPA", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[rushing_epa] ),
            "@Stuffed", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[stuffed_rushes] ),
            "@Explosive", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[explosive_rushes] )
        )
EVALUATE
SELECTCOLUMNS (
    FILTER ( __Grouped, [@Att] >= __MinVolume ),
    "Player", 'Player Season Summary'[player_name],
    "Position", [@Pos],
    "Team", [@Teams],
    "Attempts", [@Att],
    "Yards", [@Yds],
    "YardsPerCarry", DIVIDE ( [@Yds], [@Att] ),
    "TD", [@TD],
    "StuffRate", DIVIDE ( [@Stuffed], [@Att] ),
    "ExplosiveRate", DIVIDE ( [@Explosive], [@Att] ),
    "EPA", [@EPA],
    "EPAPerPlay", DIVIDE ( [@EPA], [@Att] )
)
ORDER BY [EPA] DESC
